Description: Recreates the run-specific staging and discovery directories and clears stale source-feature output.
Reads the selected RefID workbook sheet and finds matching FASTA files.
Copies the discovered FASTA files into the run-specific staging directory.
Filters master accession metadata to accessions present in staged FASTA files.
Clears old RefID metadata output and writes one filtered metadata CSV for each configured RefID rule.
Retains staged FASTA records whose accessions pass their RefID-specific metadata rule.
Creates COMET genotype and subtype assignments and removes missing or unassigned staged records.
Builds the genotype study workbook from retained sequences and COMET genotype calls.
Adds the Genotype_Counts worksheet to the genotype study workbook.
Optionally extracts GenBank source qualifiers and structured comments for matched accessions.
Optionally groups source-feature rows by RefID and source clone or isolate.
Builds the subtype study workbook from COMET calls and non-COMET priority assignments.
Uses genotype-guided BLASTX and alignment to extract NS5A amino-acid and nucleotide sequences.
Adds coordinate and divergence QC results to extracted amino-acid sequences.
Summarizes mutation burden by genotype among QC-passed input rows.
Reports which QC input accessions qualify for complete profile construction.
Builds genotype and subtype complete-profile workbooks and records included accessions.
Exports profile accessions that came from non-COMET priority assignments.
Exports genotype and subtype consensus amino-acid FASTA files from complete profiles.
Compares COMET genotype and subtype consensus sequences to reference sequences at RAS positions.
Builds the genotype-level RAS amino-acid profile.
Builds the subtype-level RAS amino-acid profile.
Builds the base combined RAS profile and related subtype coverage and sequence-audit reports.
Summarizes subtype RAS differences from the genotype consensus and creates a trend chart.
Calculates genotype consensus amino-acid distances across positions 24 through 93.
Calculates subtype consensus amino-acid distances across positions 24 through 93.
Calculates paired genotype and subtype AA and NA distances for RAS positions and positions 24 through 93.
Calculates genotype and subtype RAS entropy reports.
Creates an annotated combined profile with MeanDiff and PositionDiff values.
Updates coverage labels in the annotated combined profile.
Validates reported RAS mutations and publishes the shared reference-to-consensus report.
